Nice to meet you.
I am always looking at your wonderful illustrations.
I love the atmosphere of your illustrations and the presence of your characters,
I would love to have you draw my original character, so I made a request.

I would like to request you to draw my original character:
https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/137433943

The character is wearing a purple shirt, black vest and tie, two silver ring earrings in the left ear only, white right eye and light blue left eye.

The image of the composition is,
A 7 Star cigarette in his mouth with a downcast expression,
I envisioned the figure with a downcast expression, holding a Seven Star cigarette in his mouth, and having someone light it for him.
(The composition and pose are up to you.)

Thank you in advance for your consideration.

https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/137433943

Dear Jaw Pasta, Nice to meet you!
My name is Rinon, and I am a JoJo-loving distributor.
I have been looking at your illustrations for quite a while now, and I love Jojo and his son Ora!

I would like to make a skeb request for an illustration to be used in my distribution and social networking sites! (This is my first request on skeb, so I apologize for any shortcomings.)

The character I would like you to draw is a woman in her 20s. Her hair is half-up with silver base and green mesh from the top of her head to the side of her hair on the left side. There is a large black ribbon at the knot of her half-up hair. Her eyes are golden in color, and the shape of her eyes is almost suspensory. She has a cheerful and energetic personality, and we would be happy if you could draw her with a smile that conveys this.

Is it possible for you to draw a portrait illustration of Jojo standing in A4 size or 16:9 portrait size? I would appreciate it if you could draw it in color! We will leave the composition and other details to you!

I would like to receive a PNG image of only the person without the background, and a layered image of the background + person.
Thank you in advance!

The price was different, so I am sending it to you again! Sorry again for the delay!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-9MUV8Gf-MgwmnWx2vlG_0bBEBjzsS_U

I did not know how to express my gratitude, so please forgive me for my sidelong attempt to convey it in the form of a second commission in this way.

Nice to meet you, my name is Tomo!

I've been into JoJo since around 2020? I've seen your wonderful works on pixiv and twitter since I got into JoJo around 2020.
